data.name: Baadi
data.gender_notes: Baadi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'udda', which means 'to exalt', 'to glorify', or 'to be noble'. In Islamic tradition, the name Baadi is given to a child who is expected to live a righteous and noble life. The name Baadi carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baadi usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards spiritual enlightenment and exalted status in the sight of Allah.
data.etymology: Baadi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baadi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: بادي
in_arabic.long_meaning: بادي هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ب-د-ى' والذي يعني البداية أو الأول. في اللغة العربية، يعني الاسم الظاهر أو الذي يظهر أولاً. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الفعل 'بدى' في عدة مواضع، مما يعطي الاسم أهمية دينية وروحية في الإسلام. يستخدم الاسم بشكل شائع في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية كدلالة على البدايات الجديدة والظهور أو الانطلاق نحو مستقبل مشرق.

in_urdu.name: بادی
in_urdu.long_meaning: بادی ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ب-د-ى' کے جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شروع کرنا یا ابتداء کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام شروعات یا اولین کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم اور تاریخ میں، یہ نام ان اہم واقعات کی یاد دلاتا ہے جو اسلامی تاریخ میں ابتداء یا بدايات سے جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے کیونکہ یہ آغاز اور نئے سفر کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बादी
in_hindi.long_meaning: बादी एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है शुरुआत या प्रारंभ। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ब-د-ى' से लिया गया है, जो शुरुआत या पहले के अर्थ में है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर नए शुरुआत, पहले कदम, या किसी भी नए प्रयास की शुरुआत के प्रतीक के रूप में चुना जाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में भी महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह कुरआन में उल्लिखित कुछ शब्दों से जुड़ा है।

in_english.name: Baadi
in_english.long_meaning: Baadi is an Arabic name derived from the root 'b-d-y', meaning 'to begin' or 'first'. It signifies the starter, initiator, or the one who appears first. In Islamic tradition, the name relates to several Quranic mentions of beginnings and first occurrences. Baadi symbolizes new beginnings, leadership, and pioneering spirit. Across Muslim cultures, it is chosen for its positive connotations of initiation, renewal, and forward movement.

historical_references.reference: The city of Baadi was an important Islamic center for learning and scholarship, located in Yemen. During the Rasulid Sultanate (1224-1454 CE), it was the seat of a renowned madrasa (university) and was known for its scholars and theologians.
historical_references.context: Islamic center of learning and scholarship

historical_references.reference: In the late 18th and early 19th centuries, Baadi was the capital city of the Yemeni Imamate, ruled by Imam al-Mahdi Ahmad bin Yahya (1782-1811 CE). During this period, Baadi was known for its cultural and artistic flourishing, with the city's mosques, madrasas, and palaces being renowned throughout the Islamic world.
historical_references.context: Capital city of the Yemeni Imamate and cultural and artistic center
